versions.prompt: Mellow Japanese city pop instrumental: round electric bass, soft Rhodes keys, clean guitar chords and a laid-back drum groove, the feeling of streetlights coming on. 92 BPM. Relaxed everyday background music for a slice-of-life video game, instrumental only, no vocals. Sparse, unhurried and easy to listen to for a long time. No strings section, no orchestra, nothing epic or dramatic, no big build-up or climax. No ending: it keeps the same calm level to the end so it can loop.
